segments.text: Friends, you don't need the perfect workout routine. You just need to start. Choose one pillar and begin integrating it into your daily routine. In my personal protocol, I train for 6 to 8 hours per week. Each day I do 30 minutes of strength training, 30 minutes of cardio with mobility, flexibility, and balance work layered in throughout the day.

The most important principle isn't perfection or intensity, it's consistency. Exercise should become a habit because movement isn't just about looking younger, it's about building a body to carry you forward decades to come. >> [music] >> Peace out, immortals.
